notes: This is the single site record for the whole BNL campus. The RHIC ring's two active interaction-region halls are recorded separately as site:bnl-rhic-ip6-star and site:bnl-rhic-ip8-phenix-sphenix (both physically within this campus but without an independently sourced coordinate of their own; see their notes).

summary.plain: The main Brookhaven National Laboratory campus in Upton, on Long Island, New York — a large research site built on the former Camp Upton army base, home to the laboratory's accelerators, detectors and other scientific facilities.
summary.technical: Brookhaven National Laboratory's main site in Upton, Suffolk County, New York, built on the former U.S. Army Camp Upton; hosts the AGS/Booster injector chain, the RHIC ring with its STAR and sPHENIX detector halls, and other DOE user facilities.
